title: PIE-APT: Abductive Planning over Temporal Dynamic Knowledge Graphs via Incremental Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.27287v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Planning over Temporal Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (TDKGs) presents theoretical challenges in open-world environments with incomplete information. Existing action formalisms often face decidability issues and the Ramification Problem, while structural abduction requires expansive combinatorial search spaces. We introduce a unified framework with two modules--PIE-Abducer (incremental direct-derivation abduction) and PIE-APT (Abductive Planning for TDKGs)--operating natively on the expressive SROIQ Description Logic. Modeling state transitions as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories, we represent actions natively in OWL. This leverages an incremental reasoner to preserve decidability and natively bypass the Ramification Problem. translated_title: PIE-APT：基于增量推理的时序动态知识图谱溯因规划
translated_abstract: 在信息不完整的开放世界环境中，对时序动态知识图谱（TDKGs）进行规划带来了理论上的挑战。现有的动作形式化方法常常面临可判定性问题和分支问题，而结构化溯因推理则需要庞大的组合搜索空间。我们提出了一个包含两个模块的统一框架——PIE-Abducer（增量式直接推导溯因）和PIE-APT（面向时序动态知识图谱的溯因规划）——该框架原生运行于表达力强大的SROIQ描述逻辑之上。我们将状态转移建模为对演绎封闭的描述逻辑理论的非单调更新，并以OWL原生地表示动作。这借助增量推理机来保持可判定性，并从原生层面绕过了分支问题。为应对知识不完整的问题，PIE-Abducer避免了对最小命中集（MHS）进行枚举，它不采用组合搜索，而是将目标的逻辑否定注入一致的、表达力强大的描述逻辑理论中……
tldr: 该论文提出PIE-APT统一框架，通过将状态转移建模为对演绎封闭描述逻辑理论的非单调更新并利用增量推理机，在SROIQ描述逻辑上保持可判定性并原生绕过分支问题，同时借助增量直接推导溯因避免最小命中集的组合枚举，从而实现时序动态知识图谱上的高效溯因规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the PIE-APT unified framework, which models state transitions as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories and leverages an incremental reasoner to preserve decidability and natively bypass the Ramification Problem on expressive SROIQ description logic, while its incremental direct-derivation abduction circumvents Minimal Hitting Set enumeration to enable efficient abductive planning over temporal dynamic knowledge graphs.
